title: shipnotify has a dedicated log file, but it's always empty
description_md:
`shipnotify` is supposed to log to `/var/log/shipnotify/shipnotify.log` -- there's a dedicated rsyslog rule for it and everything -- but the file never gets a single line, even though the app is clearly running and rsyslog is clearly up. Nothing is being blackholed or silenced on purpose here; every rule in play is a legitimate one. SSH in as `trainee` (passwordless `sudo`), work out where `shipnotify`'s messages are actually ending up, and get them landing in the right place.

You're done when a fresh message from `shipnotify` actually appears in `/var/log/shipnotify/shipnotify.log`.
